data.one_liner: Transpile Sass files to CSS using Dart's build system.
data.what_it_does: It compiles .scss/.sass files into .css, supports source maps, compressed output, and custom Sass options. It also provides a read-string function to load assets as strings or data URLs.
use_when: You need to compile Sass in a Dart/Flutter web or jaspr project
You want build_runner integration for automated asset generation
avoid_when: You are not using build_runner or a Dart web project
You need a runtime Sass compiler rather than a build step
strengths: Configurable output style and source maps
data.setup_notes: Add dev:build_runner and dev:sass_builder, then run dart run build_runner build
